Co-Founder, Chairman & CEO
Thanks, Christian. Good morning, and good evening, everyone. Welcome to Aurora Mobile's 2023 first quarter earnings call. Before I comment on our Q1 results, I would like to remind everyone that the quarterly earnings [indiscernible] available on our website. You may refer to the deck as we proceed with the call today. Despite a challenging macro environment, we successfully concluded the first quarter of 2023 business and social activities slowly recovering during Q3 in a shift in COVID [indiscernible] towards the end of 2022.
Some of our businesses will impact to vary degrees. However, we are pleased to report that so far in Q2, we witnessed good momentum in revenue growth, especially from Developer Services. Although the external macro environment was murky during the first quarter, we have not stopped it, not something making our organization more efficient. We carry on with our strict cost management strategy and [indiscernible] strengthen our management structure. And as a result, our overall expenditure has continued to drop year-over-year and quarter-over-quarter.
We believe these efforts will help us improve our financial performance in the long run, which will also give us the space in a difficult environment to execute on our ambition. Here are some key financial results that I am proud to share, ROI net loss since 2019 Q3, CNY 15.2 million; ROI adjusted operating expenses since IPO at CNY 67.4 million; ROI operating expenses since IPO at CNY 64.8 million; gross margin back to 70%; [indiscernible] turnover at 39 days; before revenue balance has been higher than CNY 100 million for our [indiscernible] consecutive quarters. Total customer number remains stable [indiscernible] 4,527 up 1% up year-over-year.
Our effective cost optimization continue to earn noticeable financial results with the ROI net loss in 2019, Q3 at CNY 15.2 million and adjust operating expenses at historically low since IPO of CNY 57.4 million. We also maintained a very healthy gross margin of 70%. Now let me go through our different revenue streams. Developer Services revenue decreased 24% year-over-year, mainly due to the end services, offset by the growth in subscription services. Subscription services revenue were CNY 47.5 million, up 9% year-over-year, mainly driven by increasing ARPU. Subscription services as our core business includes [indiscernible] UMS and other products. And despite the external uncertainty environment, we sign up many well-known clients, including not limited to [indiscernible] and BYD. Going into Q2, we expect a major recovery in subscription services, and we hope we will see double-digit growth on the Q-over-Q basis.
Value additional services revenue were CNY 8.0 million, decreased by 69% year-over-year, which was a result of advertising demand we believe advertising-related revenue will continue to be impacted by the uncertain certain and volatile macroeconomic environment. Moving on to our products and services. We have seen strong growth potential and interest in the engagement platform that we launched during Q4 last year, we [indiscernible] improvements to other products under EngageLab. Recently, EngageLab has established a reliable network of data centers in multiple regions around the world to ensure that customers can choose the storage location that [indiscernible] needs. With the rapid growth in global data exchange, oversea customers held increasing data security and comparison requirements. U.S., California, Japan, Tokyo and South Korea, so UAE, Dubai, Brazil, Sapporo and Australia to me. Customers can select one appropriate data center to store data for an application based on comprehensive consideration such as the location of their end user and regulations.
We will continue to invest in technology innovation and global infrastructure building and are committed to providing our customers with the highest level of data security and compliance assurance. We are [indiscernible] to report that EngageLab has attracted numerous variable overseas customers and generate significant revenue and ARPU in just a few months. And currently, new contribution from overseas customers continue to outpace those from domestic customers, and we anticipate that our overseas business will be one of our biggest growth drivers going forward.
Our products have been well received by customers in multiple countries and regions, including the U.S., Malaysia, Thailand and Singapore. Notably, well-known companies such as BYD, [indiscernible] and Media has become our value customers. With this recognition from our customers, we remain committed to enhancing our products and services to enable global developers to achieve high efficiency and cost-effective user reach. With our app developer [indiscernible] strategy and for our ongoing improvements and iterations of products and technologies, we will continue to improve the app and have mobile app developers to answer their optional and growth demand and provide better user experience. With that, I will now pass the call to Shan-Nen, who will share more information about the clinical applications and other aspects of our performance.
Shan-Nen Bong
Chief Financial Officer
As Chris has mentioned before, we are facing external uncertainties during Q2, and our vertical application business was also challenged this quarter. Vertical Applications mainly consists of financial risk management and market intelligence. With the [indiscernible] application revenues decreased by 22% year-over-year. For both financial risk management and Market Intelligence segment. Revenues were negatively impacted and decreased by 20% and 5%, respectively, year-over-year to CNY 11.8 million and CNY 7.2 million.
Our Q1 revenue was impacted so [indiscernible] of our customers were not able to close contract on a timely basis due to the COVID outbreaks. Going into Q2, we have seen recovery in the revenue from both sectors already. Under the challenging environment in Q1 of 2023, we were still able to set up various KA customers such as [indiscernible] VIP shop just to name a few. I will now go through some of our key expenses and balance sheet items.
On to operating expenses. We are on track in our operational goal to becoming a more efficient company by centralizing our resources to focus on fewer, but more important parts. During Q1, adjusted operating expenses marked another all-time low since IPO at CNY 57.4 million. Our net loss has also narrowed down to CNY 15.2 million lower since Q3 of 2019. All three components within OpEx category recorded year-over-year and quarter-over-quarter reduction in particular.
R&D expenses decreased by 21% year-over-year to CNY 21.7 million, mainly due to lower reduced salary costs and associated share-based compensation and a decrease in cloud costs and [indiscernible] expenses [indiscernible] of our cloud platform. Selling and marketing expenses decreased by 28% year-over-year to CNY 18.9 million, mainly due to the decrease in headcount by 31.
G&A expenses decreased by 49% year-over-year to CNY 14.3 million, mainly due to an CNY 8.4 million decrease in personnel costs the CNY 2.9 million decrease in professional fees as a result of our strict cost management control strategy and a CNY 1.8 million decrease in bad debt provision as a result of our company-wide [indiscernible] on strict financial [indiscernible] measures. And adjusted EBITDA [indiscernible] compensation, reduction in force, charges, impairment improved by 9% year-over-year to negative CNY 7.5 million.
On to the balance sheet. I will again share to a very important KPI that we closely monitor. We continue to maintain a healthy AR turnover days level at 39 days. Usually, Q1 is a slower quarter because of the Chinese New Year holidays. But I'm glad to see that our persistent payment collection policy works effectively for the period. Secondly, 1 of the key financial KPI for tracking the [indiscernible] is a total deferred revenue, which represents [indiscernible] advances from customers for future contractor performance. Again, ended quarter on a high note at CNY 133.8 million. And this is the 12 quarters our deferred revenue balance exceeded CNY 100 million.
Healthy cash flow aside, the level of deferred revenue also signifies that our business is in great shape. Our customer has continued to buy our product and services quarter-over-quarter, year after year, and we are very pleased with the trending of this deferred revenue balance. Next, total assets were CNY 396.4 million as of March 2023, this includes cash and cash equivalent of CNY 88.4 million; accounts receivable of CNY 26.2 million; prepayments and other assets of CNY 33.7 million; fixed assets of CNY 11.9 million; long-term investment of CNY 141 million; [indiscernible] of CNY 27.8 million; and intangible assets of CNY 22.3 million resulted from the share SendCloud acquisition in March 2022. Total current liabilities were CNY 238 million, as of March 31, 2023. This includes short-term loan of CNY 5 million, accounts payable of CNY 18.4 million; current operating liability of CNY 18.2 million; deferred revenue of CNY 131 million; accrued liabilities of CNY 65.2 million. Lastly, before I conclude, I'll give an update on the share repurchase plan. in the quarter ended March 31, 2020, we repurchased 194,000 ADS. Cumulatively, we have repurchased a total of CNY 1.3 million [indiscernible] the start of our repurchase program. And this concludes management's prepared remarks. We're happy to take your calls nows.
